معدات:Check Valve for Fuel 
 Gas Piping

جي تي,
 إم إس 5001 ص
 General Electric USA
رقم الوثيقة: V-001-r0

صدرت إلى:
Talkha GT

حالة: 
 موافقة

إجراء:
 فحص المعدات (I1-H12000)
موافقة تاريخ: 07 Sep 2005

تاريخ ليكون 
 تمت المراجعة: Sep 2010
مقدمة

This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, 
which must be performed 
every 12000 operation hours as indicated by H12000 in the above title block.

Check valve for fuel gas piping for GT frame 5 insuring 
the supplying of natural gas for gas turbine and to check the flow in one 
direction

The first draft initiated 
by eng. 
ايهاب محمد مصطفى كامل, tested by eng. 
Abed 
Ismaiel Mohamed, accepted by eng. 
Yosry Abd El Maqsood general 
director, revised by EDEPC quality control eng. 
Abouda Elbanna، ووافق عليها المهندس. 
Fathy Mahmoud Ragab 
رئيس قطاع أبو سلطان PS.

This document accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilil; EDEPC inspection & quality control general director, MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman: 
 EDEPC admin. & financial inspection, and quality control general director and 
supervisor of inspection & quality control head sector.
احتياطات السلامة

A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff 
 should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.

Wear the safety and healthy equipment as safety 
 helmet, safety shoes, earplug, and gloves pairs...etc
Unit out of service.

Fuel system should be 
 isolated.

sections.text: Box type wrench,
Safety and healthy equipment.
العمل المراد تنفيذه
التفكيك

Remove 
 the check valve from the fuel piping.

Mount valve vertically in a suitable holding 
 fixture.

Using a box type wrench on the her of the cap 
 turn counter clock wise.

Remove wrench and care fully turn out cap by 
 hard for last two or three threads.

Remove body portion from vise. Internal parts 
 may now be tapped out by striking body against hand or other soft surface or 
 by inserting small rod in out let end and gently pushing on poppet from the 
 spring side.

Discard old flexible seal.
Valve may be cleaned.
Allow valve parts to dry thoroughly before reassembling.

items: Check metal parts for damage, replace any damaged parts.
Discard old flexible seal.
Valve may be cleaned.
Allow valve parts to dry thoroughly before reassembling.

sections.text: Mount valve body vertically as an disassembly.

Drop spring into valve making sure it seats 
 properly on spring seat at outlet end.

تجميع مانع التسرب على أنف القفاز 
 التأكد من أن شفة مثبت الختم متجهة إلى الخارج باتجاه الأنف القفاز.
حدد ختمًا مرنًا جديدًا بالحجم المناسب.

Lubricate seal by dipping in fluid from the 
 hydraulic system, proper lubrication is important to obtain correct seal 
 positioning during assembly.

قم بتجميع ختم مرن فوق أنف القفاز 
 أصبح مثبت الختم هذا الآن عبارة عن رمل محصور بين الختم والقفاز.

Drop poppet , seal retainer, and flexible 
 seal assembly into valve opening first so that poppet body slides over the 
 spring . make sure spring seats properly in poppet.

Place small amount of lubricant on 
threads of cap

Carefully stat. cap thread into body thread 
 and snug down with fingers, cap seat should properly position flexible seal 
 and seal retainer automatically and should turn down with only finger pressure 
 with in approximately turn of wrench tight.
Tighten cap with box type wrench.

Make sure spring is properly seated at both 
 sides.
Install the check valve into the fuel piping.
